facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_正印 (Earth carrying The Sage). Persona The Sage (正印). Definition line: "Nourishment that deepens without redirecting, the root that holds". Keyword Care, charge gentle, poles catalyst Wisdom / friction Comfort. Family function: Mind. Cost dimension: the root that holds; shelter that can become stillness. Arena: roots, old trees, the deep well, inherited warmth. Classical portrait: shelter and nourishment that deepens without redirecting; over-protection, "not ready yet" as a place to stay. Ruled domains: Knowledge, Shelter, Nurture. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏印.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Earth generating Metal cross-polarity — stability nourishing precision and opening direction".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Sage: mother ground, nurture in its home element, doubled. You hold people the way land holds houses, unconditionally, for generations, without once mentioning the load. Wisdom settles in you and stays. The whole village builds on your patience. Somewhere in the acreage, keep a field that feeds only you."
- k2_functional: "You think in generational wisdom: what held the family, what will hold it next."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Grounding","Enduring","Sustaining"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Knowledge":"Your knowledge is settled sediment: practical wisdom layered by years, the kind villages consult. You know what actually works. Write the almanac down. Ground should not be the only copy.","Shelter":"Your shelter is the family land itself: people return to you between every attempt at the world. Being home is holy work with no clock. Post seasons. Even land lies fallow.","Nurture":"The nourishing thread is bedrock here. Where care came early, you draw on it without thinking. Where it was missing, you became the ground yourself. Keep one plot for you."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 土_偏印 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Deep-reading","Unhurried","Inventive"],"friction":["Withdrawn","Brooding","Overprepared"]}
- Sibling cell 土_偏印 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Pulling back is where you rest, long before it is any kind of reaction. Company drains a battery in you that solitude recharges, and the door drifts toward closed on its own schedule. Nothing has to go wrong first. The pulling back is the baseline."

Core element Metal, energy element Earth. Law: Earth feeds Metal (土生金: ore grows in the mountain). Relative to the core the energy is the feeder, so Earth is this core's Mind. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Earth on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Earth as the Mind is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Playing it safe is a choice you make before looking at the other choices. You carry Earth past what you need, so you play safe to be held instead of tested. Keep in mind that you rest in the safe place rather than live in it, and you decide which it becomes.

value_b.text: You play it safe rather than find out what else there is. Because comfort feels like safety to you, you stay safe with the house you know and change your days slowly. Remember that you can be safe without being small, and you get to pick which word is yours.

value.text: Most of the time you play safe without noticing you made a choice. Because you fear the unknown more than you mind being bored, you pick the safe one and call the boredom peace. You buy that peace, bear in mind, with the chances that wanted a yes from you.

value.text: Whenever someone brings a plan to change the shared life, you play safe for both of you. Keeping things as they are wins over any change to them, so you slow every plan down. You ask them to play it safe at your speed, and it helps to remember your safe is not always theirs.

value.text: Protecting the people you love is the first thing you do with any news. Because their safety feels like your job, you protect them from a risk rather than watch them take it. Remember that you take the lesson away along with the fall, and you cannot learn it in their place.

value_b.text: You protect the people close to you before the fall rather than after it. Needing them safe runs deeper than needing them free, so you protect them before the lesson in it has reached them. Do remember that you cannot be hurt in someone's place, and you take the lesson along with the fall.

value.text: The moment trouble lands on someone you love, you protect them as if it were yours. You carry their trouble rather than let them carry it, so you pick up weight nobody handed you. Do not forget that you pay for protecting everyone by never being the one protected.

value.text: Your protection arrives before anyone has asked for it. Because watching someone struggle is harder on you than doing it for them, you protect them by taking over instead of letting them finish badly. It is worth remembering that you take a lesson with every rescue, and being needed differs from being good for them.
